purpose: approved E pose; lower face and hair complexity; compare four engraving styles

variants.title: 清爽侧脸 · 束发
variants.specific: HEAD STYLE E1: handsome classical profile with ONE long eyebrow/eye stroke and one jaw contour; no lips, ear details or beard texture. Clean face with strong nose and chin silhouette. Hair consists of just TWO large forms: swept-back crown and a small tied bun, with only one angular hairline. A single BROAD tapered hair ribbon rises from the bun to the high original star HIP89341, made from two long sides and one bend, not a plume of hair strands. Heroic and graceful, quietly classical. This is the most balanced outline option. Text: only "E1" at the top-left inside frame, small clean sans-serif.
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the approved E centaur archer composition. IMAGE 2 is its authoritative gold constellation layout. Reconstruct image 1 as BEAUTIFUL, PRACTICAL STRAIGHT-LINE ENGRAVING art for hand-scoring a 400 mm acrylic panel. Preserve E's exact expressive gesture: upper body in upper-right, face looking left-up, left arm fully extended with bow, right elbow drawn backward, arrow to left-up, four lifted horse legs, elegant long horse tail sweeping down the left side and curling at the bottom. Preserve the pose, adult anatomical proportions, horse shape, negative space and relationship with the gold star map. Gold stars and their connections belong to the shoulder/torso/horse spine and flowing tail; preserve image 2's original positions and gold graph. Main requested change: dramatically REDUCE THE COMPLEXITY OF FACE AND HAIR while keeping artistic grace. White engraving must be intentional SINGLE CONTOURS with a few selected internal anatomical strokes. No hatching, no shading, no repeated scratch strokes, no tiny triangles, no individual strands of hair, no portrait micro-detail, no eyelashes, no beard texture. The face profile, nose, jaw and neck connection must remain graceful and readable. Approximate organic contours using purposeful straight segments, mostly 8-30 mm long at panel scale; retain natural proportions, not childish geometric clipart, not a stick figure or dense triangle mesh. Consolidate body and leg linework into confident outlines and a modest amount of structure; tail consists of 4-6 broad tapered ribbons rather than many strands. Simplify curled bow terminals into elegant angular ends. Plain midnight-navy background, silver-white scoring lines and existing gold constellation, same thin square panel border. No physical photograph, no metallic fills, no additional ornaments or stars. Square artwork for easy side-by-side comparison.

variants.title: 简洁头盔 · 冠羽
variants.specific: HEAD STYLE E2: refined ancient archer helmet enclosing the head, readable left-facing profile under a single helmet brow rim. The helmet shell uses one outer contour and just one rear/neck-guard line, no engraving ornaments. Exposed nose, chin and short jaw line; optionally one eye dash only. NO hair strands at all. Crest is ONE elegant leaf-shaped faceted plume tapering upward to original high star HIP89341, completed in only 4-6 long straight lines with no feather texture. Strong, elegant, not bulky robotic head. Text: only "E2" at the top-left inside frame, small clean sans-serif.

variants.title: 纯侧脸轮廓 · 发带
variants.specific: HEAD STYLE E3: elegant anonymous celestial archer, NO internal facial marks: no eye, eyebrow, mouth or cheek lines. Beautiful side-profile silhouette with clearly shaped brow, nose, chin and neck, credible adult anatomy. Head interior is completely quiet. One long hairline separates the blank face from swept hair; hair reduced to 2 large tapered shapes and one broad flowing band connecting back of head to the original high star HIP89341 with one large kink. Very clean and poetic linework, softer character and excellent silhouette rhythm. NO mask ornaments. Text: only "E3" at the top-left inside frame, small clean sans-serif.

variants.title: 几何侧脸 · 大块分发
variants.specific: HEAD STYLE E4: sculptural angular yet anatomically elegant classical face. Inside face keep ONLY one brow-eye stroke and one cheek/jaw structural fold; no mouth, no tiny facets, no tessellation. Hair made of exactly THREE broad swept-back polygonal LOCKS with shared boundaries scored once, not a web of individual hairs. One principal hair lock extends upward as a single tapered plane to original high star HIP89341. Strong visual tension and polished engraved sculpture quality. More geometric than E1, still graceful adult proportions. Text: only "E4" at the top-left inside frame, small clean sans-serif.
